title: Preventing Discharge Delays through Planned Multi-Department Clearance
summary: Practical workflow tactics to avoid afternoon discharge bottlenecks by planning pharmacy and billing audits 24 hours prior.
content: Hospital discharge delays commonly originate in delayed billing reconciliation and unreturned medication credits. Standard procedure requires treating doctors to declare planned discharges during morning rounds before 10:00 AM. Nursing teams must submit final pharmacy return requests by 11:00 AM, allowing the billing desk to generate the draft bill and initiate TPA final approval prior to patient attender arrival.
